Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

notorious adjective

also infamous, ill-famed, well-known (for something bad), disreputable

classical

Cic. Clu. 130: omnī dēdecore īnfāmēs (Lewis & Short)
Traupman 196, 332

īnfāmis, īnfāme

declension

notorious, of ill repute

Other words

  • nōtus, nōta, nōtum — well known, notorious

    declension · also used · classical · Cic. Fam. 10.14.1: nōtissimī latrōnum ducēs (Lewis & Short s.v. nōscō); Traupman 190, 196

Examples

  • Jūdicium nōtum fīēbat.

    A notorious trial was taking place.Traupman 190

  • duōs nōtōs grassātōrēs

    two notorious hoodlumsTraupman 191

See also famous.
